company.name: RegistryLove
company.shortDescription: RegistryLove is a registry service allowing users to register products and services from anywhere and consolidate them onto one registry.
company.description: The first wedding registry to co-operate with independent retailers & big box stores, RegistryLove lets you register products and services from anywhere & consolidate them all onto ONE registry. From traditional department store items, to local gems you wouldn't find anywhere else, to your dream honeymoon & activities, RegistryLove is a service tailored to _you_.
